rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that combines global reach with local needs or characteristics.

example.english: This brand has a glocal strategy: it exports overseas while retaining its Hong Kong character.
example.traditional: 呢個品牌嘅策略係兼顧全球同本地，出口海外之餘亦保留香港味。
